orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Manoj Kumar Tiwari
orders.text:
WPSS No. 694 of 2019 
Hon’ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. Devesh Upreti, Advocate for the 
petitioner. 
Mr. Karan Anand, Advocate for the 
Union of India for 1 & 2. 
Mr. S.K. Mishra, Standing Counsel for 
the State of Uttarakhand/respondent nos. 3 
to 14. 
As prayed, four weeks’ time is granted 
to learned counsel for the respondents to file 
counter affidavit. 
Learned counsel for the respondent 
nos. 1 & 2 shall indicate in the counter 
affidavit as to whether any fund has been 
released in lieu of salary of data entry 
operator to the State Government or not. 
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.) 
NEHA 28.03.2019

orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Lok Pal Singh
orders.text:
WPSS No.694 of 2019 
Hon’ble Lok Pal Singh, J.
Mr. Jitendra Kumar, Advocate for the 
petitioners. 
 Mr. Karan Anand, Advocate for 
respondent nos.1 and 2. 
 Ms. Anjali Bhargava, Standing Counsel 
for the State/respondent nos.3 to 14. 
 Cause shown is sufficient. Delay in filing 
the counter affidavits is condoned. Delay 
condonation applications (CLMA No.6343 of 
2019 and CLMA No.7768 of 2019) are 
allowed. Counter affidavits filed on behalf of 
respondent nos.6 and 13 are taken on record. 
 Misc. application IA No.6854 of 2019 is 
allowed. Rejoinder affidavit is taken on record. 
 Learned Standing Counsel appearing 
for respondent nos.1 and 2/Union of India 
seeks and is granted two weeks’ time and 
no more to file counter affidavit. 
 List thereafter. 
 
 (Lok Pal Singh, J.) 
 10.06.2019
Rajni

orders.text:
WPSS No.694 of 2019 
Hon’ble Lok Pal Singh, J.
 
 Mr. Devesh Upreti, Advocate for the 
petitioners. 
 Mr. Rahul Consul, Standing Counsel 
for Union of India. 
 Mr. K.N. Joshi, Deputy Advocate 
General for State of Uttarakhand. 
 In view of the reasons indicated, recall 
application CLMA NO.10910 of 2019 is 
allowed. Order dated 10.06.2019 is hereby 
recalled. 
 In the facts and circumstances of the 
case, delay in filing the counter affidavit is 
condoned. Delay condonation application 
(CLMA No.13771 of 2019) stands allowed. 
Counter affidavit is taken on record. 
 As prayed, four weeks’ time is granted 
to the petitioners to file rejoinder affidavit. 
 List thereafter. 
 
 
 (Lok Pal Singh, J.) 
 17.10.2019
Rajni
